notes: A floor is not a target. A hard 1.0 means the suite is deterministic: any drop is a
regression. The model.parse floors are the recorded stock baseline (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
on the 60-case holdout sample, data/eval/chat-v0/replies/stock.jsonl) and act as a
regression floor across SFT rounds - a fine-tune that scores below the stock base model
must fail CI, not be celebrated.
A model.parse case passes only when the decision AND the accepted value are right, so
'accuracy' is correct parses, 'decisionAccuracy' is decision-only, and 'valueAccuracy'
is values among the answers the dataset accepts. Accepting the wrong value is the worst
failure mode this suite exists to catch, so it never counts as a pass.
Moving a floor changes what 'passing' means, so it is a reviewed event: quote the measured
number, the model and the reason in the commit and in docs/spec/eval-harness-v0.md.
The deterministic parser's overall agreement is deliberately NOT gated: a third of its
misses are the model's job (fuzzy labels, topicality) and the rest are recorded W1.4 gaps.
What is gated is its safety contract - no stall, and no rejected clean answer.

gates.note: no answer input raises or returns an unknown decision
an unmutated answer is never rejected
